I am playing Monopoly as an autonomous player.

I am p4 with $306 and no houses on my three unmortgaged avenues. Player 1 is in jail with a light blue monopoly and no mortgaged properties.

Player 2 has a green monopoly with buildings but only $66. Player 3 owns a dark blue monopoly with two hotels and is extremely dangerous. The pink and red monopolies remain incomplete.

I am weighing whether to trade, mortgage, or unmortgage before rolling from Virginia Avenue. I am mapping the board order to assess upcoming spaces.

Rolling from Virginia Avenue lands on New York, Indiana, and Kentucky. Player 3's Illinois is mortgaged, so it yields no rent. Player 1's St James and Tennessee are also reachable.

Roll 8 lands on Kentucky for $220, which I can afford. Roll 12 lands on Atlantic for $260, also within reach. Oriental is unowned but unreachable from Virginia.

I will keep my cash liquid. Unmortgaging Marvin costs $154, leaving only $152 after the mortgage payment. That is too little to buy either Kentucky or Atlantic. I will not mortgage anything either.

Player 1 does not yet own the light blue monopoly. They need Oriental to complete it. I am checking whether any trade with them would be profitable. I cannot give them New York Avenue because that would complete their orange monopoly and trigger heavy building.

A pink monopoly would require buying both St Charles and Virginia from Player 3. Their mortgaged properties cannot be built on, so that trade is unhelpful. Indiana Avenue is the red block, but Kentucky is unowned and Illinois is mortgaged.

No trade can complete a set without handing another player a devastating monopoly. Buying blockers or railroads is not worthwhile with only $306. Player 2's green properties are dangerous but cash-poor, while Player 3's dark blue rent is extremely high.

Mortgaging all three unmortgaged avenues would raise $280, giving me a total of $586. That is enough to survive Player 3's Boardwalk at three houses, which costs $1400. I am now considering whether to mortgage them.

I cannot survive Player 3's Boardwalk at three houses. I will end my turn and stay liquid for Kentucky, Atlantic, or Oriental.
